generic_name: Oral Electrolyte Solution (Sodium, Potassium, Chloride, and Glucose)
purpose: This solution helps replace important minerals and fluids your body loses when you are dehydrated. It is commonly used when you have diarrhea, vomiting, or are sweating heavily. It helps your body get back into balance so you feel better faster.
how_it_works: Your body needs a careful mix of salts and sugars — called electrolytes — to work properly. When you lose fluids from illness or sweating, these electrolytes get out of balance. This solution delivers the right amounts of sodium, potassium, and glucose directly into your bloodstream through your digestive system to quickly restore that balance.
common_side_effects: Most people tolerate this solution very well. Some people may feel mild nausea or bloating, especially if they drink it too quickly. These feelings usually go away on their own.
warnings: Do not use this solution if your doctor has told you to restrict fluids or salt. If you have kidney disease, heart problems, or high blood pressure, talk to your doctor before using it. Stop use and seek medical help right away if you notice swelling in your hands or feet, or if your symptoms get worse instead of better.
typical_dosing: For adults, drink small sips frequently — about 1 to 2 liters over several hours as needed. For children, follow the dosing on the package or your doctor's instructions based on your child's weight. It is best to sip slowly rather than drinking large amounts all at once to avoid stomach upset.
